parsed.explanation: The inference is invalid: |E|<|V| only forces SOME component to be acyclic; a cyclic component can coexist with isolated vertices. The objector's instance checks out: pieces 1/7,2/7,4/7 with cuts 4/7=25/70+15/70 and 2/7=11/70+9/70 give sorted parts 25,15,11,10,9 (/70), pairs {25,15} (loop at vertex 2) and {11,10} (edge 1-0), so |E|=2<3=|V| yet the component containing vertex n=2 has a loop. Since the proof specifically selects the component of vertex n and needs it loop-free/2-colourable, the chosen object can fail; the lower bound is not established as written. Repair: pick any acyclic component (one exists since a cyclic component has |E_c|>=|V_c|); (3.1) holds for every nonempty J, so vertex n is not needed.
